04/22.03.2023 Heard Mr. A.K.Kashyap, learned senior counsel for the applicant  by Mr. Anurag Kashyap and Mr. Satish Prasad, learned counsel for the State.
The applicant who is in custody since 14.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Dumri P.S. Case No.15/2022.
The applicant has been made accused for the offence under Sections 406/ 419/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471 of IPC.

It has been submitted by learned senior counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R.
alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned senior counsel for the applicant that this applicant is the President of the Bees Sutri Scheme of Dumri Block.

entities.text: Bees Sutri Scheme of Dumri Block
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: This applicant has no role in transaction of money and the matter has been settled outside the Court and the allegation is financial.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant and submitted that till date money has not travelled to the beneficiaries and as such he is not entitled for bail.
Considering the fact that beneficiaries have been deprived from the benefit of Government scheme, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The applicant who is in custody since 14.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Dumri P.S. Case No.15/2022.
The applicant has been made accused for the offence under Sections 406/ 419/ 420/ 467/ 468/ 471 of IPC.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
It has been submitted by learned senior counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R.
alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned senior counsel for the applicant that this applicant is the President of the Bees Sutri Scheme of Dumri Block.
This applicant has no role in transaction of money and the matter has been settled outside the Court and the allegation is financial.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant and submitted that till date money has not travelled to the beneficiaries and as such he is not entitled for bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Considering the fact that beneficiaries have been deprived from the benefit of Government scheme, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
applicant stands rejected.
